## Tools
- Instantly (Outbound email / sequencing; stages: solo, growth, later): Outreach Growth $47/mo, Hypergrowth $358/mo; Credits Growth $47/mo (1,500 credits). Value score: 94. Source: https://instantly.ai/pricing
- Smartlead (Outbound email / sequencing; stages: solo, growth): Base from $39/mo (pricing page also lists Pro, Smart, Prime tiers). Value score: 88. Source: https://www.smartlead.ai/pricing
- Exa (List building & lead data; stages: solo, growth): Free $10 credits/mo; Search from $4 per 1k requests (usage-based). Value score: 88. Source: https://exa.ai/pricing
- Hunter (Enrichment & verification; stages: solo, growth, later): Free (50 credits); Starter $49/mo monthly ($34 annual); Growth $149 ($104); Scale $299 ($209). Value score: 88. Source: https://hunter.io/pricing

## Stage stacks (estimates)
### Solo founder monetizing an idea: $68/mo + €19 Waalaxy
Assumptions: 1 person, 1 LinkedIn account, ~5,000 emails/mo, monthly billing, entry tiers.
- Outbound email / sequencing: Smartlead, Base, 1 workspace, $39 — Lowest published entry price for outbound email in our list.
- Enrichment & verification: Hunter, Free plan (50 credits), $0 — Free plan covers email finding/verification at solo volume.
- List building & lead data: Exa, Free $10 credits/mo, $0 — Free credits for finding target companies; Hunter then finds the emails.
- LinkedIn outreach: Waalaxy, 1 user × €19 (EUR, not converted), $0 — Cheapest listed LinkedIn tool (per user, EUR).
- Launch, content & social: Postiz, Standard, $29 — Social scheduling for founder-led content.
- Signals, intent & analytics: PostHog, Free allowance, $0 — Free product analytics allowance.
- Signals, intent & analytics: RB2B, Free plan, $0 — Free website-visitor identification; a different signal from product analytics.
### Pre-seed to Series A, growing: $401/mo 
Assumptions: 3 people, 2 LinkedIn senders, ~5,000 emails/mo, monthly billing.
- Outbound email / sequencing: Instantly, Outreach Growth, $47 — Top value score for outbound; unlimited mailboxes on one plan. Its lead credits are not added because Hunter covers enrichment.
- Enrichment & verification: Hunter, Starter, $49 — Finding and verifying emails, so no second data plan is needed.
- LinkedIn outreach: HeyReach, Growth $79 × 2 senders, $158 — Per-sender pricing scales with 2 founders/SDRs on LinkedIn.
- Launch, content & social: Postiz, Team, $39 — Social scheduling for a small team.
- Launch, content & social: HeyGen, Creator (video), $29 — Video creation (a separate job from scheduling): demos and outbound videos.
- Signals, intent & analytics: RB2B, Starter, $79 — Identifies site visitors to feed outbound.
- Signals, intent & analytics: PostHog, Free allowance, $0 — Product analytics on the free allowance.
- AI SDR / agentic SDR: Artisan, Optional — contact sales, not included, $0 — Optional; only if you want an AI SDR instead of hiring one.
### Later stage, 10+ people: $4,145/mo 
Assumptions: 10+ people, 10 LinkedIn senders, high email volume, monthly list prices except Common Room (billed annually).
- Outbound email / sequencing: Instantly, Outreach Hypergrowth, $358 — Higher-volume outbound tier on the same tool.
- Enrichment & verification: Hunter, Scale, $299 — Scale tier for team-wide email finding and verification.
- LinkedIn outreach: HeyReach, Growth $79 × 10 senders, $790 — One sender per rep on LinkedIn.
- Launch, content & social: Postiz, Pro, $49 — Social scheduling across a marketing team.
- Launch, content & social: HeyGen, Business (video), $149 — Video creation (separate job from scheduling).
- Signals, intent & analytics: Common Room, Essential (billed annually, 5 seats), $2500 — Intent and community signals across channels; replaces RB2B at this stage.
- AI SDR / agentic SDR: 11x / Qualified, Contact sales, not included, $0 — Optional AI SDR; price on request.

## Methodology
Value = 50% fit (editorial) + 30% cost + 20% sentiment; sentiment not yet verified so fit/cost reweighted 62.5/37.5.

Profitable Agent Stack is for general information only, provided "as is" without warranties. Prices, plans, features and review data change often and may be inaccurate or out of date (last checked 2026-10-26); always verify with the vendor.
